surface: The Alignment submenu of the context menu: its parent item, ArrowRight into the submenu, an item of it, and ArrowLeft and Escape back out.

steps.note: The setup opens the context menu on A1 and moves the highlight to Read only; ArrowDown highlights Alignment, the parent of a submenu (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded false). Required: its label, and that it opens a submenu: every reader says `collapsed`.

ArrowRight opens the submenu with its first item, Left, highlighted; NVDA reads `table. Left`. Finding: VoiceOver reads the parent item again, `Alignment expanded menu item`, and not the item the focus moved to, on both browsers.

ArrowLeft closes the submenu, and the highlight should return to its parent item, Alignment. Finding: the focus falls to the document. The parent menu takes the keys again (`listen()`), but nothing focuses its Alignment item, so every reader reads the page's title as a document (`Context menu checked items e2e fixture, document`).
Escape closes the context menu, and the focus should return to the grid's A1. Finding: no reader says anything: the focus is still on the document the previous step left it on.
